description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符，建议使用UUID。过期时间为3天。
description.en: A client-generated token that you must use to ensure request idempotence. The token must be unique for each request, contain only ASCII characters, and be no longer than 64 characters. Using a UUID is recommended. The token is valid for 3 days.
The ID of the API MCP service.
